sections.title: charaNam 2
lyrics: kanakāvRshtiya kareyutha bArE - manakAmaneyA siddhiya thOre
dhinakarakOtI thEjadhi hoLeyuva - janakarAyanA kumAri bEga

sections.title: charaNam 3
lyrics: attittagaLadhe bhakthara maneyali - nithya mahOthsava nitya sumaṅgala
sathyava thOruva sAdhu sajjanara - chittadhi hoLeyuva putthaLi bombe

sections.title: charaNam 4
lyrics: shaNkhyE illada bhAgyava kottu - kaNkaNa kaiyA thiruvutha bAre
kuṅkumAṅkithe paṅkaja lOchane - vEṅkata ramaNana biṅkadha rANI

sections.title: charaNam 5
lyrics: sakkere thuppada kAluveharisi - shukra vAradhA pUjeya vELege
akkereyuLLa aLagiri ranganana - chokka purandhara viTTalana rANI
